changeSet.author: Anton Pampukha
changeSet.comment: Change chat_state_updated_at from timestamp without time zone to with time zone
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE telegram_chat ALTER COLUMN chat_state_updated_at TYPE TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE USING chat_state_updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE telegram_chat ALTER COLUMN chat_state_updated_at TYPE TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE USING chat_state_updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
